title: Flight Canceled After Child Refuses to Sit Down
paragraphs: Many parents know that it can be hard to make a young child sit still. But on one flight in Canada, a child's behavior caused the whole flight to be canceled.

It happened in early August 2026 on a Porter Airlines flight. Porter is an airline from Toronto. The plane was at Victoria International Airport, in British Columbia, and it was going to fly to Toronto.

Before the plane took off, a young child refused to sit down and put on a seatbelt. On a plane, all passengers must sit down and wear their seatbelts when the plane takes off. The child's parent tried many times to get the child to sit in the seat. The flight attendants also tried to help. But the child still refused.

Because of this, the plane had to go back to the terminal. There, the parent, the child and their bags were taken off the plane. But this took a long time. The airport closes its runway at 12:30 a.m., and the plane could not leave before then. So, the flight was canceled, and all the other passengers had to get off the plane.

The passengers were given seats on a flight the next day. One passenger said that "it took forever" for the parent and child to leave the plane. The passenger was also unhappy with the airline's communication.
Porter Airlines said that the parent and the crew tried many times to help the child sit down. The airline also said it was sorry to the other passengers.
